description: This file is a mock implementation of the IarmBus interface used for testing purposes. It leverages Google Mock to provide default behaviors for the IARM_Bus-related methods, simulating interactions with the IarmBus in tests.

classes.name: IarmBusImplMock
classes.description: A mock class inheriting from IarmBusImpl, used for unit testing components that depend on IarmBus. It sets up default behaviors for the bus operations.
